title: HR Administrator
description:
**Hrisha Lighting Projects LLP** · Bodakdev, Ahmedabad

About us

Hrisha Lighting Projects LLP is an architectural lighting company in Bodakdev, Ahmedabad. We work with architects, interior designers, developers and consultants on commercial, hospitality and luxury residential projects across Gujarat.

We distribute lighting, execute projects on site, and build our own brands: Mirakle (technical and decorative lighting) and Quiklit (solderless profile lighting for modular furniture). Our team of about 35 works across our office, godowns, in-house assembly and project sites — we're at the size where HR needs systems, not just paperwork.

The role

You'll run day-to-day HR and office administration for our team — hiring, records, attendance, compliance and the office itself. You'll be the first point of contact for staff queries and new joiners, and report directly to the Managing Partner. As we grow, you'll help turn our HR policies and grade structure into everyday practice.

Key responsibilities

**Recruitment and onboarding**

* Run hiring end to end for office, sales, warehouse and site roles: post jobs, screen CVs, schedule and conduct first-round interviews, and run reference checks.
* Coordinate practical tests and final interviews with team heads, and keep a live tracker for every open role.
* Prepare offer and appointment letters, collect joining documents, and run a structured first-week induction.

**Records, attendance and payroll inputs**

* Maintain complete employee files — KYC, documents, signed policies — and issue HR letters: confirmation, increment, experience and relieving.
* Track attendance and leave, and share verified payroll inputs with Accounts every month.
* Support the appraisal and salary revision cycle with attendance and performance data.

**Statutory compliance**

* Handle PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund: employee registrations, monthly returns and on-time payments with Accounts.
* Maintain statutory registers and licences, and keep our practices in line with the new Labour Codes.
* Coordinate POSH compliance: Internal Committee records, awareness sessions and the annual report.

**Employee relations and exits**

* Be the first point of contact for employee queries on policies, leave and benefits.
* Roll out HR policy updates, keep signed acknowledgements on file, and plan festival celebrations and team events.
* Run exit formalities — handover, asset recovery, exit interview — and close full-and-final inputs within the Labour Code timeline.

**Office administration**

* Run the office day to day: housekeeping, pantry, stationery, courier and printing.
* Manage facility vendors and maintenance contracts — AC, internet, CCTV and electrical — for the office and godowns.
* Issue and recover company assets: laptops, phones, SIM cards and ID cards.
* Track rent agreements, insurance and licence renewals, and book travel for outstation visits.

**Reporting**

* Share a monthly HR report: headcount, joinings, exits, attendance and open positions.

What we're looking for

**Must have**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, business or a related field.
* 2–5 years in HR and administration, ideally in a company of 25–200 people where you handled the full employee lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with PF, ESIC and Professional Tax portals and monthly payroll inputs.
* Experience hiring for both office roles and warehouse or site staff.
* Good MS Office: Excel (XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, pivot tables) and letter drafting in Word.
* Fluent Gujarati and Hindi; good written English for letters and email.
* Attention to detail and complete discretion with confidential data.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of the Labour Codes and POSH compliance.
* Experience with HRMS or attendance software.

**You'll do well here if you**

* Close every loop: each candidate, query and document gets a response.
* Stay calm and fair in sensitive conversations.
* Build simple systems and checklists instead of relying on memory.
* Keep records audit-ready without reminders.

How to apply

Send your CV to **krutish@hrishalightings.com** with the subject "HR & Admin Executive – Your Name".

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst I - Global Project Management
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The **Analyst I, Global Project Management Operations** supports the planning, execution, governance, and reporting of strategic projects across global operations. This role is responsible for coordinating project activities, maintaining project documentation, tracking milestones, managing project data, and supporting governance processes to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

The role partners closely with project managers, functional teams, business stakeholders, and global operations leaders to drive project excellence, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Project Coordination & Execution**

* Support end-to-end project execution activities across multiple global initiatives.
* Coordinate project meetings, workshops, and governance reviews.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and action items.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project activities.
* Maintain project schedules and update progress against defined plans.

### **PMO Governance & Reporting**

* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and governance presentations.
* Monitor project health indicators, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure project documentation complies with PMO standards and methodologies.
* Support weekly, monthly, and quarterly project review cadences.

### **Data Analysis & Insights**

* Analyze project performance metrics and provide actionable insights.
* Develop and maintain reports using Excel, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
* Support data-driven decision-making through project analytics and trend analysis.
* Identify project bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

### **Risk & Issue Management**

* Track and maintain project risk and issue logs.
* Escalate critical risks and challenges to project leadership.
* Support mitigation planning and follow-up activities with stakeholders.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with cross-functional teams including Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT, HR, and Transformation teams.
* Facilitate communication between global stakeholders and project teams.
* Support project communication plans and executive updates.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to standardize project management processes.
* Support implementation of PMO best practices and operational efficiencies.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across project delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, Technology, or a related field.

### **Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Operations, Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience supporting cross-functional projects in a fast-paced environment preferred.
* Exposure to project management methodologies and governance processes is desirable.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Jira, or similar project management/reporting tools preferred.
* Ability to manage and analyze project-related data effectively.
* Familiarity with project planning and tracking tools.

### **Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.

**Success Measures**
====================

* Timely completion of project deliverables and milestones.
* Accuracy and quality of project reporting and dashboards.
* Effective tracking and resolution of project risks and issues.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement.
* Adoption of PMO standards and governance processes.
* Contribution to operational efficiency and project success metrics.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management)
* PMP (in progress) or equivalent project management certification
* Agile/Scrum Fundamentals certification preferred

**Location(s)**
---------------

Ahmedabad - Venus Stratum GCC

**Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager - HR (Plant) Job in Kadadra, Gujarat**

Lubi Electronics is looking for an experienced and proactive **Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager - HR (Plant)** to manage end-to-end HR operations at our manufacturing plant in **Kadadra**. The role encompasses full ownership of plant HR operations, Industrial Relations (IR), Employee Relations (ER), manpower planning, talent acquisition, statutory labor compliance, performance management, employee welfare, and HR MIS. The ideal candidate must have proven plant HR experience within a manufacturing or automation environment.

**Eligibility & Education Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related discipline.
* **MBA / PGDM in Human Resources** is highly preferred.
* **4–8 years** of relevant HR experience within a plant/factory manufacturing setup.
* Prior background in plant HR operations within manufacturing or industrial automation is essential.

**Job Details**

* **Position:** Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager - HR (Plant)
* **Location:** Kadadra, Gujarat
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Vacancies:** 01
* **Experience:** 4 to 8 Years

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle:**

* Direct complete employee lifecycle processes including joining, onboarding, probationary confirmation, internal transfers, personnel files, and exit clearances.
* Manage daily attendance, shift rosters, leaves, separations, and end-to-end HRMS workflows.
* Collate, validate, and coordinate monthly plant payroll inputs with the central payroll team.

**2. Industrial Relations & Employee Relations:**

* Manage shop-floor discipline, employee relations (ER), and day-to-day Industrial Relations (IR) at the plant.
* Draft and issue show-cause notices, charge sheets, warning letters, and conduct domestic enquiries in alignment with legal standards.
* Maintain healthy relations with workforce representatives and manage contract labor agencies.

**3. Statutory Compliance & Factory Audits:**

* Ensure 100% adherence to applicable Indian labor laws and factory acts.
* Coordinate and monitor statutory compliance for PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), Bonus, Gratuity, CLRA (Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act), and the Factories Act.
* Maintain statutory registers, submit annual returns, and represent the company during labor inspections and social/statutory audits.

**4. Manpower Planning & Recruitment:**

* Forecast manpower demands and execute hiring drives based on production targets.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Logistics departments to ensure optimal operator and staff staffing.

**5. Training, Welfare & Engagement:**

* Organize technical, safety, behavioral, and statutory compliance training programs for plant employees.
* Drive employee welfare initiatives, overseeing canteen services, bus transportation, uniforms, personal protective equipment (PPE), and medical room provisions.
* Plan and execute employee engagement programs to promote motivation and retain talent.

**6. Performance Management & HR MIS:**

* Execute Performance Management System (PMS) cycles, appraisals, and employee KPI reviews at the plant level.
* Maintain comprehensive HR MIS dashboards, tracking attrition, absenteeism, OT costs, and hiring turnaround metrics for management reviews.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Solid practical knowledge of plant HR administration and blue-collar/white-collar workforce management.
* Hands-on experience in managing Industrial Relations (IR), grievance handling, and disciplinary actions.
* Deep understanding of the Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, PF, and ESIC regulations.
* Expertise in contract labor contractor management and shop-floor productivity tracking.
* Strong interpersonal, mediation, conflict resolution, and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in HRMS software, MS Excel, and HR MIS analytics.

**Apply Now**

Share your updated resume at **hr1@lubielectronics.com** or call/WhatsApp **+91 90810 83834**.

title: HR Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**HR EXECUTIVE**

**Position**

HR Executive

**Reports to**

Managing Partner (functionally also to the Head of Operations)

**Location**

Head Office, Ahmedabad — with regular travel to project sites and asphalt plants

**Experience**

3–6 years in HR / personnel / labour compliance, preferably with a construction, infrastructure or manufacturing company

**Qualification**

Graduate in any discipline; MBA/MSW/PGDM in HR or a Diploma in Labour Law an advantage

**CTC**

₹ 2,40,000 – ₹ 4,20,000 per annum (₹ 20,000 – ₹ 35,000 per month), based on experience

**Employment**

Full time, on the rolls of Saurabh Builders

**About us**

Saurabh Builders is an AA-class registered Gujarat government infrastructure contractor based in Ahmedabad, executing bituminous road, RCC and structural works for Gujarat R&B, GIDC, AMC, VMC and other departments. We operate asphalt batch mix plants at Dhansura (Arvalli), Vadodara and Valsad, an AMC Division at Ahmedabad, and a fleet of over 54 commercial vehicles and construction machines. The group also includes a sister entity, Propave Infra LLP.

**Purpose of the role**

This is the company's first dedicated HR position. Hiring, joining paperwork, statutory records and site labour compliance are presently handled by the management alongside everything else. You will take complete ownership of the employee life cycle — from hiring to exit — and of every statutory register, return and record that a labour inspector, PF officer or departmental auditor can ask for.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment and onboarding**

* Source and screen candidates for site and office positions — site engineers, supervisors, plant operators, surveyors, billing and accounts staff, drivers and operators — through job portals, consultants, referrals and local networks.
* Coordinate interviews, carry out reference checks with the last two employers of every candidate, and verify qualification and experience certificates before any offer is issued.
* Issue appointment letters, collect signed acceptances, and complete the full joining documentation set — joining form, document checklist, confidentiality undertaking, PPE issue, site cash advance undertaking and induction checklist.
* Maintain the onboarding tracker as the single source of truth, and report pending items for every employee without being asked.

**2. Statutory compliance and records**

* EPFO: UAN generation and linking within 30 days of joining, Form 11 and Form 2, monthly ECR preparation and payment by the 15th, exit date marking, and resolution of member grievances.
* Professional Tax: monthly deduction, remittance and returns under the Gujarat Act; ESIC registration and monthly contribution wherever an employee falls within the wage ceiling.
* Maintenance of wage registers, muster rolls, overtime, leave and attendance records, site-wise, in the formats required under the Code on Wages, 2019 and the OSH&WC Code.
* Compliance under the BOCW Act and the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act for our sites — registrations, licences, returns, and verification of sub-contractor compliance.
* Preparation for and handling of labour, PF and departmental inspections, including production of any document within five minutes of being asked.
* Tracking of the statutory calendar and advance warning of every due date to the management.

**3. Payroll inputs and attendance**

* Collect and verify attendance from all sites and plants every month, including overtime, leave without pay and site allowances, and issue clean payroll inputs to accounts by the agreed cut-off.
* Prepare salary structures for new hires on the company CTC calculator, keeping Basic at or above 50% of CTC and checking the ESI position at every revision.
* Coordinate TDS declarations and investment proofs with the accounts team, and resolve salary and PF queries of employees.

**4. Site labour and contractor management**

* Verify the labour strength deployed by sub-contractors at each site against their bills, and check their PF, ESI and wage compliance before certification.
* Ensure every worker at site holds valid identity records, has been given PPE, and has received the safety induction before entering a live carriageway.
* Handle site-level grievances, discipline, show-cause notices and warning letters in consultation with the management.

**5. Records, systems and reporting**

* Maintain one complete folder per employee — KYC, statutory forms, correspondence — scanned within the week a document is signed.
* Run the probation review cycle: Day 7, Day 30 and the six-month confirmation decision, with written outcomes.
* Process exits — resignation, notice period, handover and clearance, PF exit marking and full and final settlement.
* Report monthly to the management on headcount, joinings and exits, attrition, statutory status and open compliance items.

**What we are looking for**

* Working, hands-on knowledge of the EPFO employer portal, the Gujarat professional tax system and ESIC — not theory, you should have filed these yourself.
* Practical understanding of the Code on Wages 2019, the OSH&WC Code, BOCW and CLRA as they apply to a government works contractor.
* Experience maintaining wage registers and muster rolls for multiple sites, and facing at least one labour or PF inspection.
* Strong Excel — this company runs on trackers and registers, not on expensive software.
* Fluent Gujarati and Hindi, and workable written English for letters and departmental correspondence. Many of our site staff read only Hindi, so documents must be explained to them in their own language.
* Willingness to travel to sites and plants at Dhansura, Vadodara, Valsad and within Ahmedabad.
* A person who tells the management what is pending and what is overdue, rather than letting it pass quietly.

**Good to have**

* Experience with a contractor registered with Gujarat R&B, AMC, GIDC, NHAI or a similar authority.
* Exposure to payroll software (Zoho People, Keka, GreytHR) and to digital attendance at site.
* Experience drafting bilingual (English–Gujarati or English–Hindi) forms and notices.

**What success looks like in the first 90 days**

* Every employee on the rolls has a complete, signed document file and a UAN linked within the statutory time limit.
* The PF, PT and ESI calendar runs without a single late payment or return.
* Wage registers and muster rolls are current and site-wise, and can be produced on demand.
* Open positions are filled within an agreed time, with reference checks done before the offer.
* The management is told, every month, exactly what is pending and what is coming due.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
